parameters.query: WITH ap AS (UPDATE approvals SET status = 'approved', decided_by = 'staff_1', decided_at = now(), executed_at = now(), execution_result = 'classified', decision_note = 'دفعة من عميل للسفر للعراق' WHERE id = 3 AND status = 'pending' RETURNING id), tx AS (UPDATE finance_transactions SET category = 'دخل من عميل - رحلة العراق', scope = 'office', note = 'دفعة من عميل للسفر للعراق', status = 'confirmed', reviewed_at = now() WHERE id = 2 RETURNING id), rule AS (INSERT INTO work_playbook (scope, title, when_text, action_text, priority, created_by) SELECT 'finance', 'تجاهل تحويلات IBAN BH18BIBB...30', 'أي حركة مالية واردة أو صادرة طرفها IBAN يبدأ بـ BH18BIBB وينتهي بـ 30', 'تجاهلها تماماً: ليست تابعة للمالك، لا تُسجل كحركة ولا يُسأل عنها', 'low', 'staff_1' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_playbook WHERE title LIKE 'تجاهل تحويلات IBAN BH18BIBB%') RETURNING id), ign AS (UPDATE approvals SET status = 'rejected', decided_by = 'staff_1', decided_at = now(), decision_note = 'ليست تابعة للمالك (قاعدة تجاهل الحساب)' WHERE request_type = 'tx_review' AND status = 'pending' AND (summary ILIKE '%BH18BIBB%' OR (details->>'tx_id')::int IN (SELECT id FROM finance_transactions WHERE raw_text ILIKE '%BH18BIBB%')) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ap) AS a3, (SELECT count(*) FROM tx) AS tx2, (SELECT count(*) FROM rule) AS rule_added, (SELECT count(*) FROM ign) AS ignored;
